messages:
marta: Dropping the Q3 OKR draft for company-level sign-off. Main tradeoffs: speed of Dedicated pilot vs broad Hosted improvements. Please react or comment with hard blockers.

marta: Draft pasted below. Will update after quick sync.
```
OKR Q3 - Reliability & Commercialization
O1: Make inference reliably cheaper & faster for high-volume customers
  - KR1: Reduce p50 latency across top 10 models by 20% from baseline
  - KR2: Reduce average hosted token cost per 1M tokens by 18%
O2: Launch Dedicated Pilot & close initial customers
  - KR1: Run Dedicated pilot with 3 paying customers (POC -> contract)
  - KR2: Achieve Dedicated SLO: p95 < 350ms for <=512 tokens on pilot configs
O3: Shipping developer features that lower operational burden
  - KR1: Console: rollout & canary controls GA; adoption by 5 internal teams
  - KR2: Optimize autoscaler to reduce overprovisioning by 25% for steady workloads
LAUNCH CRITERIA (Dedicated Pilot):
  - Ramp to sustained 500 rps across pilot pool
  - SLO compliance 30d rolling at 99.9%
  - Cost/unit below $0.02 for target workload profile
```

eli: Nice concise draft. Quick notes: 1) I worry KR1 latency target — is 20% across top 10 realistic without Dedicated? 2) Sales wants measurable commercial acceptance metric (POC -> contract is good).

raj: 20% p50 is attainable if we prioritize batching + kernel swap for the top 3 models. For top10 it's tight. We can do a staged approach: 20% on top3, 10% on next7, which we can roll into one KR or split. Needs Dedicated infra allocation for pilot.

anya: Console work for rollout/canary controls will need UI + backend flags. Estimate 2 engineering sprints + 1 design sprint to hit GA for basic flows. Also RBAC changes for Dedicated customers.

marta: Good catch. Proposal: update KR to "Reduce p50 latency for top3 models by 20% and next7 by 10%". I'll edit. Also adding explicit rollout risk and dependency on Dedicated infra.

dana: From GTM: add KR under O2: "3 POC wins with defined acceptance criteria" so sales has something to drive. Also need pricing guardrail for pilot.

simon: From research: we should add a KR about quality regression monitoring — small model/quant changes can drift; suggest "No more than 2% regressions on eval prompt set during rollout".

marta: Good call, adding monitoring KR under O1.

eli: Can someone add a final line about executive signoff process? e.g., "this draft is approved by execs X/Y/Z or needs exec review on Thurs"

marta: Plan: collect sign-offs here by EOD Tue. If everyone OK, we'll move to exec deck Wed AM.

raj: Short note on risks: if Dedicated infra slips, we should have fallback: reduce Dedicated scope and extend Hosted optimizations to cover early customers. I'll add a fallback bullet in the doc.

marta: Done — fallback described.

anya: FYI design will need access to sample pilot accounts to prototype pricing UI. @marta can you loop in engineering?

marta: @anya absolutely, will create a ticket and tag eng infra.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline for pilot infra created: pipeline-id `deploy-pilot-1851`. Automated smoke tests pending.

dana: With those edits, GTM signs off on the KR set and launch criteria. We'll prepare messaging and success stories.

raj: Eng sign-off pending capacity confirmation, but technical approach looks good. Marking as +1 conditional.

simon: +1 on quality monitoring and evaluation plan.

eli: OK. I'm signing off pending final doc edits (latency KR phrasing and sales metric). Once updated, consider this approved from execs. :thumbsup:

marta: Updated doc with the phrasing changes, added sales KR, monitoring KR, and fallback. Linking new draft: https://redwood.internal/okrs/q3-company-draft (internal).

marta: Thanks all — I'll assemble final slide deck and ping for a quick run-through before exec deck.

eli: Thanks — great tradeoff clarity.

marta: Closing thread: moving to exec deck. If any last comments, add inline in the doc by EOD.
